Warehousing

Konsolidasi Pesanan

The process of grouping multiple orders or order lines for the same consignee into a single shipment, referenced in outbound logistics, WMS, and consolidated shipping documents.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Konsolidasi Pesanan?

In this glossary, Konsolidasi Pesanan refers to: The process of grouping multiple orders or order lines for the same consignee into a single shipment, referenced in outbound logistics, WMS, and consolidated shipping documents.

How is Konsolidasi Pesanan used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Konsolidasi pesanan mengurangi biaya pengiriman dan menyederhanakan proses kepabeanan dengan menggabungkan beberapa pesanan untuk satu penerima menjadi satu pengiriman."

Why does Konsolidasi Pesanan matter in logistics?

Konsolidasi Pesanan matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Konsolidasi Pesanan?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The process of grouping multiple orders or order lines for the same consignee into a single shipment, referenced in outbound logistics, WMS, and consolidated shipping documents.

Operational example

Order consolidation reduces shipping costs and simplifies customs clearance by merging multiple orders for a single consignee into one shipment.

Localized term

Konsolidasi Pesanan

Localized example

Konsolidasi pesanan mengurangi biaya pengiriman dan menyederhanakan proses kepabeanan dengan menggabungkan beberapa pesanan untuk satu penerima menjadi satu pengiriman.
